text: The sympathetic innervation for the gastrointestinal tract, including the regions involved in this patient's symptoms of intermittent loose stools and constipation, originates from the thoracic and upper lumbar segments of the spinal cord (T5-L2). Specifically, the celiac ganglion and superior mesenteric ganglion receive preganglionic fibers from T5-T9, while the inferior mesenteric ganglion receives fibers from L1-L2. CONFIDENCE: 85.
